hook: A thirty-five megabyte Mac browser for Arc refugees.

beats.say: Zigzag is a free, open-source Mac browser, written in Swift on WebKit, for people leaving Arc.
Your tabs live in a sidebar, grouped into spaces. It's about thirty-five megabytes installed, with no account and no telemetry.
It was built by a high school student in Shanghai, and needs macOS fifteen point four or later.
